title: Compact-support coefficient projection cocycle before exceptional adjoints
statement: Let a,b be composable coefficient changes, with arbitrary commutative coefficient rings, elements and monotone reindexings. Fix a compactification c of a scheme morphism and actual strict compact-support realizations S1,S2,S3 [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. Fix normalized exact coefficient transports Xij,Yij,Zij at the source, target and compactification, and compact-support transports P12,P23,P13 [def-pur-strict-etale-coefficient-transport-interfaces]. There exist tensor-unit-normalized ordinary and representative-normalized derived composition isomorphisms AX,AY,AZ for these transports. For every K, their derived components satisfy S3.functor(AX_K) ≫ P13.projection.inv_K = P23.projection.inv_(X12 K) ≫ Y23(P12.projection.inv_K) ≫ AY_(S1 K). No exceptional right adjoint, finite coefficient ring, quotient flatness or derived evaluation faithfulness is assumed.

source.place: Zheng, Construction 4.1, Construction 5.15 and Proposition 2.29(2); tensor/adjunction normalization underlying the coefficient composition step.

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-strict-etale-transport-associator at X,Y,Z to obtain the ordinary unit-normalized associators. On complexes paste the factorization isomorphisms of the two coefficient transports with the complex of each ordinary associator. Localization.liftNatIso descends this natural isomorphism. Its representative formula follows from liftNatTrans_app and cancellation of the last factorization isomorphism. Pairing it with the ordinary associator yields AX,AY,AZ.

Apply lem-pur-strict-etale-inverse-transport-composition to the open inverse-image squares, and multiply by their inverses to get the corresponding equation for their inverse transformations. The mate equivalence commutes with pasting (mateEquiv_vcomp), and is natural under transformations of both coefficient functors. Apply its inverse and the openMate equations of P12,P23,P13 to obtain the open-extension composition equation. Apply the same pasting and naturality formula forward to the proper inverse-image squares, using properMate, and cancel inverses to get the proper-direct-image inverse comparison equation.

Expand each inverse compact-support projection as proper direct image of the open-comparison hom followed by the proper-comparison inverse. Apply the proper direct-image functor to the open composition equation, then substitute the proper inverse-comparison composition equation. Naturality of the second proper comparison moves the first open comparison past it. Functoriality recombines the remaining two maps as Y23 applied to P12.projection.inv. This is exactly the required equation for every K.

proof_origin.place: Construction 5.15, coefficient composition; ordinary associator and one inverse-image square isolated, derived associators, mate pasting, and projection algebra implemented in Lean by C2.

lean.statement: theorem strictEtaleCompactSupportTransport_composition {O₁ O₂ O₃ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing O₁] [CommRing O₂] [CommRing O₃] {ell₁ : O₁} {ell₂ : O₂} {ell₃ : O₃} {phi₁₂ : O₁ →+* O₂} {phi₂₃ : O₂ →+* O₃} {r₁₂ r₂₃ : ℕ →o ℕ} {a : StrictEtaleCoefficientChange O₁ O₂ ell₁ ell₂ phi₁₂ r₁₂} {b : StrictEtaleCoefficientChange O₂ O₃ ell₂ ell₃ phi₂₃ r₂₃} {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c : Compactification f} {S₁ : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O₁ ell₁ c} {S₂ : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O₂ ell₂ c} {S₃ : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O₃ ell₃ c} {X₁₂ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a X S₁.PX S₂.PX} {Y₁₂ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a Y S₁.PY S₂.PY} {Z₁₂ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a c.Z S₁.PZ S₂.PZ} {X₂₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport b X S₂.PX S₃.PX} {Y₂₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport b Y S₂.PY S₃.PY} {Z₂₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport b c.Z S₂.PZ S₃.PZ} {X₁₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport (a.comp b) X S₁.PX S₃.PX} {Y₁₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport (a.comp b) Y S₁.PY S₃.PY} {Z₁₃ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport (a.comp b) c.Z S₁.PZ S₃.PZ} (P₁₂ : StrictEtaleCompactSupportTransport a c S₁ S₂ X₁₂ Y₁₂ Z₁₂) (P₂₃ : StrictEtaleCompactSupportTransport b c S₂ S₃ X₂₃ Y₂₃ Z₂₃) (P₁₃ : StrictEtaleCompactSupportTransport (a.comp b) c S₁ S₃ X₁₃ Y₁₃ Z₁₃) : ∃ (AX : StrictEtaleTransportComposition X₁₂ X₂₃ X₁₃) (AY : StrictEtaleTransportComposition Y₁₂ Y₂₃ Y₁₃) (_AZ : StrictEtaleTransportComposition Z₁₂ Z₂₃ Z₁₃), ∀ K, S₃.functor.map (AX.derived.hom.app K) ≫ P₁₃.projection.inv.app K = P₂₃.projection.inv.app (X₁₂.derived.obj K) ≫ Y₂₃.derived.map (P₁₂.projection.inv.app K) ≫ AY.derived.hom.app (S₁.functor.obj K)
